profile.name: Varun Vyas
profile.heroEyebrow: Senior Data Engineer | Azure Databricks & Cloud Platforms
profile.heroIntro: I’m a Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years building dependable data platforms across finance, automotive, and process mining. I turn complex source systems into trusted, decision-ready data using Azure Databricks, Spark, Python, SQL, and cloud services.
aboutParagraphs: I’m Varun, a Senior Data Engineer with more than five years of experience designing data pipelines and platforms for enterprise teams. I currently build Azure Databricks lakehouse solutions for SAP finance data.

My work spans Medallion Architecture, Unity Catalog, PySpark, Airflow, AWS, data quality, and governance. I care about measurable outcomes: reliable pipelines, faster reporting, and data that people can use with confidence.
profile.contactIntro: I’m glad to connect about data engineering, Azure Databricks, lakehouse architecture, and building dependable pipelines that solve real business problems.

projects.title: Enterprise finance lakehouse
projects.description: Built a Bronze-to-Silver-to-Gold lakehouse on Azure Databricks and ADLS Gen2 for SAP ECC finance data across 54 business units, processing 3.5 TB daily. Unity Catalog added centralized governance and fine-grained access controls for 200+ schemas.

projects.title: Faster, trusted process insights
projects.description: Orchestrated incremental Celonis API pipelines into Azure Databricks and SQL Server, cutting process-mining report generation from 24 hours to under 45 minutes. Automated PySpark validation reduced reconciliation errors by 98.5%.

projects.title: High-throughput spatial pipelines
projects.description: Built distributed AWS Glue and PySpark ingestion for more than 15 million daily spatial records, improving query runtime by 40%. A Gemini-powered batch workflow also automated address transliteration across 13 Indic languages.
